name: What colors make a small bathroom look bigger?

mainEntity.name: What colors make a small bathroom look bigger?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small bathroom appear more spacious, light and cool colors are generally recommended. Shades of white, off-white, light gray, pale blues, and soft greens can reflect light, making the room feel brighter and more open. Using a monochromatic scheme or painting the ceiling a lighter shade than the walls can also contribute to an expansive feel. Consider glossier finishes to further enhance light reflection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Light and cool colors like whites, pale blues, and soft greens can make a small bathroom look bigger by reflecting light.
